title.narrative: Enhancing Crisis Management and Cybersecurity Resilience of the MFA

description.narrative: The overarching goal of the project is to strengthen the long-term institutional resilience of the Moldovan MFA by modernizing its crisis management system and bolstering its cybersecurity capabilities. As a result, the MFA becomes more effective, accountable, and resilient institution, equipped to manage crises and safeguard its critical operations. To achieve this goal, the project will deliver on the following outputs: 1) MFA’s crisis management and cybersecurity policy frameworks are revised, ensuring a more adaptive, gender specific and effective response to crises; 2) MFA’s crisis management infrastructure is improved, allowing for efficient and secure communication, especially during emergencies; 3) Crisis management and cybersecurity capacities of MFA staff are strengthened through gender-responsive capacity building and the integration of modern technologies. The Project will design and deliver a series of targeted gender-responsive training programs tailored to the roles and responsibilities of MFA staffers – from senior leadership to technical and operational personnel. By combining gender-responsive capacity development with the deployment of secure digital tools, the MFA staffers will be better prepared to manage and respond to crises, contributing to a more resilient, inclusive, and digitally capable foreign policy institution.
